MAC regular season champions |bowl = [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2016–17 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Akron Zips men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Akron]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Zips, led by 13th-year head coach [[Keith Dambrot]], played their home games at the [[James A. Rhodes Arena]] as members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 27–9, 14–4 in MAC play to win the MAC East Division and MAC overall regular season championship. They defeated [[2016–17 Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball team|Eastern Michigan]] and [[2016–17 Ball State Cardinals men's basketball team|Ball State]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2017 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] where they lost to [[2016–17 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]], losing in the championship game for the second consecutive year. As a regular season conference champion who failed to win their conference tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2016-17 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the first round before losing to [[2016–17 Texas–Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|Texas–Arlington]]. Following the season, head coach Keith Dambrot left the school on March 30, 2017 to accept the head coaching position at [[Duquesne Dukes men's basketball|Duquesne]].{{Cite web|url=https://pittsburgh.cbslocal.com/2017/03/27/reports-duquesne-u-hires-keith-dambrot-as-new-basketball-coach/|title=Duquesne U. Hires Keith Dambrot As New Basketball Coach|date=27 March 2017|access-date=2017-04-11}} On April 5, the school hired former [[Ohio Bobcats men's basketball|Ohio]] and [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] head coach [[John Groce]] to replace Dambrot.{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2017/04/05/akron-hires-former-illinois-coach-groce-to-replace-dambrot/100070290/|title=Back in MAC: Akron hires former Ohio, Illinois coach Groce|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-04-11|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Akron Zips men's basketball team|Zips]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 26–9, 13–5 record in conference, winning the East Division title as well as the overall regular season MAC championship. The Zips defeated [[2015–16 Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball team|Eastern Michigan]] and [[2015–16 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team|Bowling Green]] to advanced to the championship of the [[2016 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] where they lost to [[2015–16 Buffalo Bulls men's basketball team|Buffalo]]. As a regular season conference champion who failed to win their conference title, they received an automatic bid to the [[2016 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost to [[2015–16 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]] in the first round. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
